text: 金十数据11月11日讯，大东方公告，公司A股股票于2026年11月10日、11月11日连续2个交易日收盘价格涨幅偏离值累计达20.38%，属于股票交易异常波动情形。2026年11月3日至11月11日，公司7个交易日内5个涨停，累计涨幅65.32%，显著高于同期行业指数涨幅，存在非理性炒作、快速下跌风险，预计全年市盈率显著高于行业水平。经自查及向控股股东、实控人询证，不存在应披露未披露的重大事项，董监高及控股股东、实控人在异动期间未买卖公司股票。公司2026年前三季度营业收入19.41亿元，同比下降26.61%；归母净利润840.92万元，同比下降84.8
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 11 — Large Oriental announced that the cumulative deviation of the closing price increase of the company's A-shares over two consecutive trading days, November 10 and November 11, 2026, reached 20.38%, constituting an abnormal fluctuation in stock trading. From November 3 to November 11, 2026, the company hit the daily limit up 5 times in 7 trading days, with a cumulative increase of 65.32%, significantly higher than the industry index increase over the same period, posing risks of irrational speculation and rapid decline, and its estimated full-year price-earnings ratio is significantly higher than the industry level. After self-examination and inquiries to the controlling shareholder and actual controller, there are no major undisclosed matters that should be disclosed, and during the abnormal period, directors, supervisors, senior management, the controlling shareholder and the actual controller did not buy or sell the company's shares. In the first three quarters of 2026, the company's operating revenue was 1.941 billion yuan, down 26.61% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders was 8.4092 million yuan, down 84.8%.
